# Third-party: sec-miri-pure (slot 190)

No new dependencies and no copied code. Miri is the rustup `miri` component of
the nightly toolchain (MIT OR Apache-2.0, https://github.com/rust-lang/miri),
used as a tool only; nothing from it is linked or vendored.
